tools.name: vporiadku_list_invoices
tools.description: List invoices and other documents (invoice, proforma, advance, quote, …) with filters. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD. Returns { data, total, page, limit }. Vporiadku API: GET /invoices.

tools.name: vporiadku_get_invoice
tools.description: Get one invoice or document with its lines, VAT, totals, amount due and bank details. Vporiadku API: GET /invoices/{id}.

tools.name: vporiadku_list_invoice_payments
tools.description: List the payments recorded against one invoice. Vporiadku API: GET /invoices/{id}/payments.

tools.name: vporiadku_list_clients
tools.description: List clients (the client directory) with search by name, IČO, DIČ or e-mail. Vporiadku API: GET /clients.

tools.name: vporiadku_get_client
tools.description: Get one client with its address, IČO, DIČ and contacts. Vporiadku API: GET /clients/{id}.

tools.name: vporiadku_list_items
tools.description: List items and services of the catalogue (Profi plan). Vporiadku API: GET /items.

tools.name: vporiadku_get_item
tools.description: Get one catalogue item with its price, VAT rate and unit. Vporiadku API: GET /items/{id}.

tools.name: vporiadku_list_expenses
tools.description: List received documents (expenses) with filters for status, category, period and changes. Profi plan. Vporiadku API: GET /expenses.

tools.name: vporiadku_get_expense
tools.description: Get one received document (expense) with its lines, VAT breakdown and payment details. Vporiadku API: GET /expenses/{id}.

tools.name: vporiadku_list_due_payments
tools.description: List the supplier payments that are due up to a date. Vporiadku API: GET /supplier-payments/due.

tools.name: vporiadku_list_payment_orders
tools.description: List payment orders (batches of supplier payments). Vporiadku API: GET /payment-orders.

tools.name: vporiadku_list_received_invoices
tools.description: List e-invoices received in the inbox. Reading marks nothing as read. Vporiadku API: GET /received-invoices.

tools.name: vporiadku_get_received_invoice
tools.description: Get one received e-invoice with its lines and VAT breakdown. Vporiadku API: GET /received-invoices/{id}.

tools.name: vporiadku_list_recurring_invoices
tools.description: List recurring invoice schedules and their latest runs (read-only). Vporiadku API: GET /recurring-invoices.

tools.name: vporiadku_list_companies
tools.description: List the companies the workspace issues documents under; the default one is marked. Vporiadku API: GET /companies.

tools.name: vporiadku_list_bank_accounts
tools.description: List the bank accounts that documents are paid into; the primary one is marked. Use the id as bank_account_id when creating an invoice. Vporiadku API: GET /bank-accounts.

tools.name: vporiadku_create_invoice
tools.description: Create an invoice or other document with lines and VAT. It is saved as a draft: it is not issued, not sent, and can still change. Vporiadku API: POST /invoices.

tools.name: vporiadku_update_invoice
tools.description: Change fields of an existing document. Only the fields you pass change. Passing items replaces all lines. The API refuses a change it does not allow (for example to a locked document) and says why. Vporiadku API: PATCH /invoices/{id}.

tools.name: vporiadku_issue_invoice
tools.description: Issue a draft: it becomes an issued document and is locked for edits. An issued document cannot be changed later; the app issues a credit note or a cancellation instead. Vporiadku API: POST /invoices/{id}/issue.

tools.name: vporiadku_send_invoice
tools.description: E-mail the document to its client. This sends a real e-mail to the customer; it fails if the client has no e-mail address. Vporiadku API: POST /invoices/{id}/send.

tools.name: vporiadku_send_invoice_reminder
tools.description: E-mail a payment reminder for an unpaid document to its client. This sends a real e-mail to the customer. Vporiadku API: POST /invoices/{id}/reminder.

tools.name: vporiadku_record_invoice_payment
tools.description: Record a payment received for an invoice. The document status follows the payments. Vporiadku API: POST /invoices/{id}/payments.

tools.name: vporiadku_mark_invoice_paid
tools.description: Mark the whole open amount of an invoice as paid on a date. Vporiadku API: POST /invoices/{id}/mark-paid.

tools.name: vporiadku_create_client
tools.description: Add a client to the directory. The API checks for a duplicate by IČO, DIČ or name unless allow_duplicate is true. Vporiadku API: POST /clients.

tools.name: vporiadku_update_client
tools.description: Change fields of a client. Only the fields you pass change. Vporiadku API: PATCH /clients/{id}.

tools.name: vporiadku_create_item
tools.description: Add an item or service to the catalogue (Profi plan). Vporiadku API: POST /items.

tools.name: vporiadku_create_expense
tools.description: Record a received document (an expense) from a supplier, with optional lines. Profi plan. Vporiadku API: POST /expenses.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: vporiadku_list_received_invoices, vporiadku_list_companies, vporiadku_mark_invoice_paid · Private data: vporiadku_list_invoices, vporiadku_get_invoice, vporiadku_get_client, vporiadku_list_expenses, vporiadku_get_expense, vporiadku_list_companies, vporiadku_list_bank_accounts, vporiadku_create_invoice, vporiadku_update_invoice, vporiadku_issue_invoice, vporiadku_send_invoice, vporiadku_send_invoice_reminder, vporiadku_record_invoice_payment, vporiadku_create_expense · Public sink: vporiadku_create_invoice, vporiadku_issue_invoice, vporiadku_send_invoice, vporiadku_send_invoice_reminder, vporiadku_record_invoice_payment, vporiadku_mark_invoice_paid, vporiadku_create_client, vporiadku_create_item, vporiadku_create_expense.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: vporiadku_list_received_invoices, vporiadku_list_companies, vporiadku_mark_invoice_paid · Private data: vporiadku_list_invoices, vporiadku_get_invoice, vporiadku_get_client, vporiadku_list_expenses, vporiadku_get_expense, vporiadku_list_companies, vporiadku_list_bank_accounts, vporiadku_create_invoice, vporiadku_update_invoice, vporiadku_issue_invoice, vporiadku_send_invoice, vporiadku_send_invoice_reminder, vporiadku_record_invoice_payment, vporiadku_create_expense · Public sink: vporiadku_create_invoice, vporiadku_issue_invoice, vporiadku_send_invoice, vporiadku_send_invoice_reminder, vporiadku_record_invoice_payment, vporiadku_mark_invoice_paid, vporiadku_create_client, vporiadku_create_item, vporiadku_create_expense

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
